limitations: These labels score the frozen 120-case HTTP replay only; they are not CSAT, FCR, or online success rate.
The source HTTP observation is explicitly excluded from the normal quality denominator.
The review is bound to one immutable answer/source report and does not generalize to future Provider outputs.
Release thresholds were not predeclared for this already-captured run, so the result remains quality evidence rather than a retroactive gate.
Review labels are human-approved with disclosed AI text/recording assistance; the evidence does not claim unaided human authorship.
